title: Business Process Taxonomy
description: Hierarchical process taxonomy (end-to-end -> area -> process -> activity). Built on Microsoft's Business Process Catalog, which supplies the initial fifteen end-to-end domains, and extended with additional domains where the catalog has no equivalent. Not a 1:1 mirror.

source.description: Link or filename of the upstream Microsoft BPC source.
Where the node came from. 'bpc' = imported from Microsoft's Business Process Catalog; 'cookbook' = defined here. Lets ingest_bpc.py refresh the catalog without deleting locally defined nodes.

parent.description: id of parent node; omitted for end-to-end

bpmn.description: relative path to .bpmn file under taxonomy/bpmn/
